newsitem.title: USA: Sun sets July for Marcus Hook reformer turnaround.
newsitem.headline: Sun sets July for Marcus Hook reformer turnaround.

text.p: Sun Co said on Tuesday it will take down its 15,000 barrel per day (bpd) reformer at the Marcus Hook, Pennsylvania refinery for a 20 day turnaround beginning July 18.
There will not be a scheduled turnaround at Sun's 75,000 bpd reformer at the 307,000 bpd Philadelphia Refinery this third quarter, the company said.
The 175,000 bpd Marcus Hook refinery is operated in conjuction with the Philadelphia refinery as part of Sun Northeast Refining, one of Sun's seven business units.
